title: REQ · Every committed manifest path is checked against a list of present files with fs mocked
summary: A helper and a mocked-fs test compare all committed manifest asset paths to a present-files list.
description: Context: loadManifestFile checks existence per asset via existsSync but offers no reusable comparison against a file list. Desired behavior: an exported pure helper returns manifest asset paths absent from a supplied file list; the test feeds it the committed manifest read through mocked fs. Expected result: drift between manifest.json and asset folders fails the test. Why: prevents silent drift.
acceptance_criteria: Given the committed manifest and a list of all its paths, when the helper runs, then it returns an empty array.
Given the list with one path removed, when the helper runs, then it returns that single path.
Given node:fs is mocked, when the test runs, then no real asset file is touched.
technical_constraints: Helper must be pure and not throw
